messages.content: What is the time difference between Los Angeles and Berlin?

message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time Zone) is usually **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time).  
During daylight‑saving periods it’s **8 hours behind** because both regions shift forward at different times of the year.  

| Period | Los Angeles | Berlin | Difference |
|--------|-------------|--------|------------|
| Standard Time (roughly early November – mid-March) | UTC−08:00 | UTC+01:00 | +9 h |
| Daylight Saving Time (mid-March – early November) | UTC−07:00 | UTC+02:00 | +8 h |

So if it’s noon in Los Angeles, it’s 9 pm in Berlin during standard time, and 8 pm during daylight‑saving time.
